presentation.label: CROSSFADER
presentation.summary: A crossfader between two groups of tracks and inputs, on LEVEL on the Internal Mixer, on the tracks you choose, or a CC.
presentation.overview: Every audio track and both inputs (IN L, IN R) can go in group A, group B or neither on SETTINGS > CROSSFADER. One fader fades between the groups with an equal-power curve: at one end group A plays at its own level and group B is silent, at the other end the reverse. The fader is LEVEL on the Internal Mixer page, LEVEL on the pages of the tracks you put on FADER ON, or a CC of your choice on FX CONTROL CH. It is the last layer on each channel's level, and the delay and reverb sends follow it.
highlights: An equal-power fade between two groups of tracks and inputs; the sends follow it.
LEVEL is the fader on the Internal Mixer and on the tracks you choose; FUNC + LEVEL jumps to the middle.
A CC on FX CONTROL CH moves it from a controller.
Groups and settings are saved on the +Drive for the whole unit.
usage: Press SETTINGS, go down to CROSSFADER (the last row) and press YES.
Put some tracks in group A and others in group B with LEFT and RIGHT; press NO to leave.
Press FUNC + LFO twice for the Internal Mixer and turn LEVEL: group A fades out as group B fades in.
FUNC + LEVEL jumps to the middle, where both groups play at -3 dB.

access.location: SETTINGS > CROSSFADER; LEVEL on the Internal Mixer (FUNC + LFO, 2/3) and on FADER ON tracks' pages
steps: Press SETTINGS, go down to CROSSFADER and press YES.
Set each track and input to A, B or – with LEFT and RIGHT; tick tracks on FADER ON with their trig keys.
Press FUNC + LFO twice for the Internal Mixer and turn LEVEL.

controls.name: SETTINGS > CROSSFADER
controls.doc: Each track and input in group A, B or – (neither); FADER CC (a CC number on FX CONTROL CH, or OFF); FADER ON (the tracks whose pages make LEVEL the fader, toggled with trig keys 1-16). Saved for the whole unit on the +Drive.

controls.name: LEVEL (fader pages)
controls.doc: The crossfader, 0 (group A) to 127 (group B), equal-power. Turns as a stock knob: pushed for big steps, FUNC + LEVEL jumps to the middle, then to the end. Pushing LEVEL alone there does nothing.

limitations: Built for OS 1.54 only, on Core 2.1.
The groups, the fader CC and FADER ON are saved for the whole unit, not per project or pattern; the fader position is not saved.
It is the last layer on each channel's level: track levels and the External Mixer still apply, and the delay and reverb sends follow the fade.

load.display: Adds 0.5-0.7% of an audio block over stock (emulator)
load.conditions: Emulator: OS 1.54, Core 2.1, demo pattern playing; 3,000 blocks with the MCF5441x timing model at 250 MHz, zero-wait memory. Core alone 60.3% mean, 62.0% worst block; with Crossfader and no groups 60.8% and 62.5%; with all ten channels in groups and the fader at 64, 61.0% and 62.8%. Not a hardware measurement.

tests.summary: Emulator (digiemu, OS 1.54, CF01): the CROSSFADER page, groups, FADER ON, the fader on the Internal Mixer and on a FADER ON track, load measured. Before the split, the combined LF03 build passed every crossfader check on draadpiraat's Digitakt I; the hardware run of CF01 is pending.
